role: FileShareButton, the share button that stands where a ShareLink stood for export files: it writes its file only when tapped (off the main actor), presents the system share sheet from the topmost view controller (presentFileShareSheet), which deletes the file once it closes, shared or cancelled, and raises 'Export failed' when the file cannot be written; and ShareFileItem, the activity item that gives the sheet a title and icon (LPLinkMetadata) while every destination receives the file.
types: FileShareButton<Label>: struct (View) — title, iconName, makeFile (@Sendable async throws → URL), label
ShareFileItem: class (NSObject, UIActivityItemSource) — file URL with a header title and SF Symbol
state: mem:FileShareButton.preparing (@State, true while the file is being written; disables the button)
toplevel: @State preparing and failed start false; no other stored initialisers.

units.does: Stores the sheet title, icon name, file writer and the built label.
A Button showing the label that starts share() in a Task; disabled while preparing; carries the 'Export failed' alert (OK) bound to failed.

Unless a write is already running: marks preparing (cleared on exit), awaits makeFile (off the main actor); on a throw logs it at .warning and sets failed (the 'Export failed' alert); with no presenter (topmostPresenter nil) deletes the file at once; else presents it with presentFileShareSheet(title, iconName), which deletes it when the sheet closes.
calls: closure:FileShareButton.makeFile — the export writer the share site passes

branches.effect: delete the file, return; else present

units.does: Stores the file URL, header title and optional SF Symbol name.
The placeholder the sheet sizes its destinations by: the file URL.
The item every destination receives: the file URL.
The sheet's header: an LPLinkMetadata with the title and, when the SF Symbol exists, its image as the icon.

branches.cond: icon name given and the symbol exists
